sloka: इह राम महातेजाः सुतीक्ष्णो नम धार्मिकः ।वसति अरण्ये नियतः स ते श्रेयो विधास्यति ॥३-५-३५॥
transliteration: iha rāma mahātejāḥ sutīkṣṇo nama dhārmikaḥ ।vasati araṇye niyataḥ sa te śreyo vidhāsyati ॥3-5-35॥

translations.english: Here dwells in this forest a brilliant saint, righteous and selfcontrolled, Sutikshna by name who will look to your welfare, O Rama
